FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE MAWATHAGAMAPRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONSORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resignation ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the United National Party, the recognized political party to which KankaniArachchi Appuhamilage Disna Chamani Janaranjana the member belonged, was required by me under section 66A(1) ofthe aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned member if United National Party who belongs to such party and is notdisqualified under section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a memberwithin a period of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Karunarathna Appuhamilage Ajantha Kumari to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE Gamalathge Dlip Nishantha, Returning Officer of the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabhaacting in terms of selection 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare thatKarunarathna Appuhamilage Ajantha Kumari was selected as the member of the Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha.
GAMALATHGE DLIP NISHANTHA,Returning Officer,Mawathagama Pradeshiya Sabha.
